''), NULLIF(TRIM(a.job_type), '') ) AS "jobType", a.safety_helmet_id AS "safetyHelmetId", a.personnel_status AS "personnelStatus", a.safety_education AS "safetyEducation", a.identity_card AS "identityCard", a.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", a.helmet_returned AS "helmetReturned", a.departure_type AS "departureType", a.departure_reason AS "departureReason", a.departure_date AS "departureDate", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.status AS "status" FROM swm_person a -- 原有的关联查询（通过fms_worker关联）- 应用去重逻辑 Author: Shawn Date: 2025-09-18 LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fms_worker fw2 WHERE fw2.identity_code = f.identity_code AND fw2.create_date > f.create_date ) LEFT JOIN js_sys_office o ON f.office_code = o.office_code AND o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive p ON f.work_shop_code = p.id AND p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON f.work_group_id = wg.id LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line fpl ON fpl.id = wg.prod_line_id -- 备用关联查询（直接使用swm_person表中保存的ID进行翻译） LEFT JOIN js_sys_office backup_o ON a.company = backup_o.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_o.zip_code IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive backup_p ON a.department = backup_p.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group backup_wg ON a.team = backup_wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line backup_fpl ON a.prod_line = backup_fpl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_work_type backup_wt ON a.job_type = backup_wt.work_type_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE a.personnel_status = '1' AND ( p.id = #{departmentCondition} OR wg.id = #{departmentCondition} OR fpl.id = #{departmentCondition} OR o.office_code = #{departmentCondition} OR a.identity_card = #{departmentCondition} OR a.company = #{departmentCondition} OR a.department = #{departmentCondition} OR a.prod_line = #{departmentCondition} OR a.team = #{departmentCondition} OR a.job_type = #{departmentCondition} ) AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC

LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive backup_p ON a.department = backup_p.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND backup_p.type = 'CJ' LEFT JOIN fms_work_group backup_wg ON a.team = backup_wg.id COLLATE SELECT DISTINCT a.id AS "id", a.NAME AS "name", a.person_type AS "personType", a.gender AS "gender", jso.office_name AS "company", pa.position_name AS "department", pl.prod_line_name AS "prodLine", wg.work_group_name AS "team", a.job_type AS "jobType", a.safety_helmet_id AS "safetyHelmetId", a.personnel_status AS "personnelStatus", a.identity_card AS "identityCard", a.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.STATUS AS "status", a.is_external_personnel AS "isExternalPersonnel", f.id AS "workerArchiveId", a.company AS "officeCode", a.department AS "positionArchiveId", a.team AS "workGroupId", a.prod_line AS "prodLineId" FROM swm_person a LEFT JOIN fms_position_archive pa ON a.department = pa.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_prod_line pl ON a.prod_line = pl.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_work_group wg ON a.team = wg.id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN swm_work_type backup_wt ON a.job_type = backup_wt.work_type_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN js_sys_office jso ON a.company = jso.office_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN fms_worker f ON a.identity_card = f.identity_code COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fms_worker fw2 WHERE fw2.identity_code = f.identity_code AND fw2.create_date > f.create_date) WHERE a.personnel_status = '1' -- 只查询在职人员 AND a.status = '0' -- 正常状态 ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
